questions.question: What will be the day of the week on 08 June 2030?
questions.solution:
Concept:

 
 

 Year
 Odd Days
 
 

 100
 5 odd days
 
 

 200
 3 odd days
 
 

 300
 1 odd days
 
 

 400
 0 odd days
 
 

 

 
 

 Leap Year
 2 Odd days
 
 

 Ordinary Year
 
 
1 Odd day

 
 
 

Given date: 08 June 2030.

In 2000 Years the odd day is 0,

Now, calculate the odd days from 2000 to 2029:

Normal years (non-leap) = 23 years → 23 odd days

Leap years = 7 years → 7 × 2 = 14 odd days

Total odd days = 23 + 14 = 37

Since 37 ÷ 7 = remainder 2,

The number of odd days from 2000 to 2029 is **2**

Now,

Total odd days from January 2030 to June 08, 2030

 
• January = 31 days → 3 odd days
 
• February = 28 days → 0 odd days
 
• March = 31 days → 3 odd days
 
• April = 30 days → 2 odd days
 
• May = 31 days → 3 odd days
 
• June 1-7 = 7 days → 0 odd days
 
• June 8 = 1 day → 1 odd day

 

= 3 + 0 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 0 + 1 = 12

Since 12 ÷ 7 = remainder 5,

The odd days from January to June 8, 2030, are** 5.**

Now, add up all the odd days:

Odd days from 2000 to 2029 = 2

Odd days from January to June 08, 2030 = 5

Total odd days = 2 + 5 = 7

Since 7 odd days = 0 (Sunday cycle), the day on 08 June 2030 is Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Saturday".

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All papers are books.

Some books are notebooks.

All notebooks are files.

Conclusions:

I. Some papers are notebooks.

II. All books are files.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
From above statement,

All papers**(P)** are books**(B)**.

Some books are notebooks(**N)**.

All notebooks are files**(F)**.

The venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81707e536a35053e01d1e69ef1444f546f8f3f0c27de0e1804cc44a3b6e4f98d.png] 

**Conclusion I: Some papers are notebooks.**(False)

We only know that **all papers are books** and **some books are notebooks**, but it is not necessary that any paper is a notebook.

There is no direct or indirect link confirming that any paper is also a notebook.

**Conclusion II: All books are files.** (False)

**Some books are notebooks**, and **all notebooks are files**.

However, this does not mean that **all books** are files—only some books (those that are notebooks) are files.

**So, the correct answer is Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**

questions.question:
What will come in place of the ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

56 + 12 − 54 × 18 ÷ 6 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403e2c9b2d83d2833bbe332aec98802c4e44f6e941082c10c340b3da1d47692b.png] 

Given,

 
 

 Sign
 +
 - 
 ×
 ÷ 
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 - 
 +
 ÷ 
 ×
 
 

 

Replacing the sign in equation, 

56 + 12 − 54 × 18 ÷ 6 = ?

We, get 

56 - 12 + __**54 ÷ 18**__ × 6 

→56 - 12 + __**3**____** × 6 **__

→56 - 12 + 18 = **62**

The correct answer is "option 2".
